mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.shop_id, c.name, c.parent_id, c.sort_order, c.status, c.recommend, c.image, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p WHERE p.category_id = c.id AND p.shop_id = c.shop_id) AS product_count FROM categories c WHERE c.shop_id = #{shopId} ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.shop_id, c.name, c.parent_id, c.sort_order, c.status, c.recommend, c.image, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p WHERE p.category_id = c.id AND p.shop_id = c.shop_id) AS product_count FROM categories c WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.shop_id = #{shopId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO categories (shop_id, name, parent_id, sort_order, status, recommend, image) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{name}, #{parentId}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{recommend}, #{image})
mapper.update: UPDATE categories SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id} AND shop_id = #{shopId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM categories WHERE id = #{id} AND shop_id = #{shopId}
